description: we are high schoolers who want to learn about space and try out new interesting things.
summary:
In 2026, technology and internet access have become part of children's everyday lives. That's why we created Little Astronaut Academy, an interactive online platform that makes space education accessible to children worldwide, especially those with limited learning opportunities.

Our website offers age-appropriate information about space, astronauts, and space-related careers through educational content, games, and interactive missions. With support for five languages, we aim to overcome language barriers and make space education accessible to more children around the world.

Our goal is to inspire curiosity, develop an early interest in space, and build a strong foundation for the next generation of scientists, engineers, astronauts, and space professionals.
details: Our site has a settings part where you can choose the age and language. Our site now has 5 languages but we'll add more in the future. This site includes 6 parts. Home page, activities, games, story time and check points. We are planning to add leader board to make kids more competitive. And our site has a staff called Zog its a chat bot who answers the questions about the astronaut training. The site has a streak points and kids can collect starts to compete with each other.
